chapter.verse: Tua hun pawlin Kumpi Herod in pawlpi mite kimkhat' tungah ngongtatna tungsak hi.
Namsau tawh John' sanggampa James that a,
Jew mite thukim lungkim cih a muh ciangin Peter mat ding tawh zomto hi. Hih pen Silngo Sawhloh Anlum Pawi hun sung ahi hi.
A mat khit ciangin Paisan Pawi man khit Jew mipi' mai-ah lahkhiat ding ngimna tawh thong sungah khum a, a cing dingin galkap beelpawl li tungah ap hi.
Tua bangin Peter pen thong sungah kikem a, ahih hangin pawlpi in ama' adingin Pasian' kiangah deihphatak thungen uh hi.
Tu-in Peter pen Herod in thudong dingin a lakkhiat kuan, zan hunin galkap nih kikal ah khutkol nih kibulhin ihmu a, thongcingte in thong kongpi mai-ah cing uh hi.

Tua ciangin, en un, Peter' gei-ah Topa' vanmi khat ding a, thong inndei sung zong khuavak taang hi. Vanmi in Peter a pang pan khoihin phong a, “Manlangin tho in,” ci hi. Tua lianleh Peter' khut-a khutkolte kitolkhia hi.
Tua ciangin vanmi in Peter' kiangah, “Kithawi inla na khedap bulh in,” ci hi. Peter in zong tua bangin hih hi. Tua ciangin vanmi in, “Na puantual silh inla hong zui in,” ci hi.
Peter zong pusuakin vanmi zui hi. Ahih hangin vanmi' tungtawna thupiang pen a taktak ahihlam thei lo-in muhtuam khat a ngah kisa lel hi.

Thongvilna mun a khatna leh a nihna a khenkhit uh ciangin khuapi sung paina sik kongpi tung uh hi. Kongpi ama' thu-in kihongtawm a, amau zong pusuakin lamzikno khat zui uh hi. Tua lianleh vanmi in Peter paikhiatsan hi.
Peter khua a phawksiang ciangin, “Topa in ama' vanmi hong sawlin Herod' khutsung pan leh Jew mihonpi' lamet thu pan hong honkhia ahihlam tu-in ciantak ka theitel ta hi,” ci hi.
Hih thu Peter in a phawk ciangin mi a tamkhop khat thungenin a kikaihkhopna uh Mary' inn ah pai hi. Mary pen Mark cih min dang a nei John ii nu ahi hi.
Inntual kongpi a kiuh ciangin konghon dingin Rhoda minnei sawltangzangnu hong pai hi.
Peter' aw cih a theih ciangin nuam lua ahih manin kongpi hon lo pi-in lehtai-in kongpi ah Peter ding cih thu va ko hi.
Amaute in, “A hai hiteh!” cihsan uh hi. Himah taleh a takpi mah ci teitei ahih manin amau zong, “Tua pen ama' vanmi hi!” mah cici uh hi.
Ahih hangin Peter in kong kiu suaksuak a, kong a hon uhleh Peter mu uh ahih manin lungmang uh hi.

Peter in a gamdaih nadingun khut a van khit ciangin thong sungpan Topa' paikhiatpihna thu teng sutkik a, “Hih thute James leh sanggam teng' kiangah na gen un,” ci hi. Tua ciangin pusuakkhia a, mun dang khat ah khualzin hi.
Tu-in khuavak ta a, Peter bangci ta ci-in galkapte lakah buaina a hoihkhop khat piang hi.
Herod in zong zongin a muh loh ciangin thongcingte dongtel a, tua mite kaikhia-a thah dingin thupia hi. Tua ciangin Judea gam pan Caesarea khua ah paisuk a, tua takah taam hi.

Tu-in Herod pen Tyre leh Sidon khuamite' tungah heh hi. Tua ciangin amaute kilungtuakin Herod' kiangah pai uh a, kumpipa' innsung ukpa Blastus a pawlzot khit uh ciangin Herod' kiangah nopna lemna thu pulak uh hi. A hang pen annek tuidawn vai ah tua khua nihte Herod' kumpigam tungah kinga uh ahih man hi.
Kiciam ni ciangin Herod pen a kumpi puan teng silhin thukhenna tokhom tungah tu a, amaute' tungah ulian thugenna khat nei hi.
Tua ciangin mihonpi awng uh a, “Hih pen mihing' aw hikei, pasian' aw hi!” ci uh hi.
Thakhat thu-in Topa' vanmi khat in Herod vatsuk hi. Pasian' tungah minpha a piak loh huhau hi a, amah than in ne-in a husan bei hi.
Ahih hangin Pasian' thu ahihleh phungpha-in khanglian hi.
Barnabas leh Saul zong panpih nasep vai a man khit uh ciangin Jerusalem pan ciahkhia uh a, Mark mindang a nei John zong tonpih uh hi.
